name: Clay
tagline: Clay is a data enrichment and go-to-market platform that pulls contact and company data from 75+ sources, then uses AI to write personalised outreach at scale. Its AI Research Agent browses the web to find specific signals about a prospect — recent news, job changes, tech stack — and incorporates them into emails automatically. Outbound sales teams use Clay to build hyper-targeted prospect lists and personalise at a volume that was previously impossible.
